spans.s:
mfn. (-हः-ही-हं)
Belonging or relating to the grandfather, inherited from him, (property, &c.)
E.
पितामह, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Paternal, ancestral, belonging or relating to the father or to progenitors.
E.
पितृ a father, ठञ् aff.

f. (-मिः)
1 Father-land, the country of one's ancestors.
2 A paternal estate.
E.
पैतृक, and भूमि land.

m. (-यः)
A paternal aunt's son.
f. (-यी)
The daughter of a paternal aunt.
E.
पितृ a father, स्वसृ a sister, aff. ढक्, whence the vowel of स्वसृ is rejected.

mf. (-यः-या)
The son or daughter of a father's sister.
E.
पितृ a father, स्वसृ a sister, छण् aff. whence the ऋ of स्वसृ is changed to री.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ती-त्तं)
Biliary, bilious.
E.
पित्त, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Bilious, biliary.
E.
पित्त, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं)
Paternal, ancestral, relating or belonging to a parent or progenitor.
n. (-त्रं)
1 The part of the hand between the thumb and forefinger, or according to some the root of the forefinger.
2 A year, month, day, &c. of the Pitṛs.
E.
पितृ a parent, aff. अण्.

m. (-त्रः)
A day and night of the Pitṛs, or progenitors, equal to a month of mortals.
E.
पैत्र relating to the manes, अहन् a day, and रात्रि night.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Paternal, ancestral.
E.
पितृ, and ठञ् aff. and the vowel changed.
